en-US.author: Xianwei Zhu
en-US.description: Hide windows and icons, or keep working locally with Ghost Mode on supported captures.
en-US.longDescription:
gohide hides the running applications you choose - their windows, taskbar buttons and even their
system-tray icons - with a single global hotkey, then restores everything exactly where it was.
Most classic window hiders stopped working on the redesigned Windows 11 notification area; gohide
still hides tray icons there. It can also mute an app while hidden, or suspend it entirely so a
hidden game stops using CPU and GPU. Everything is fully reversible, works offline, and needs no
account and no telemetry. Free for up to 3 managed apps; an optional Pro tier is a one-time
perpetual purchase with no subscription.
Ghost Mode (Pro) keeps selected windows usable locally while excluding content from supported captures.
en-US.name: gohide
en-US.releaseNotes:
gohide 6.3.0 expands Ghost Mode, a core workflow alongside window hiding. Keep selected windows visible and usable locally while excluding their content from supported captures.
• New Ghost shortcuts bar for switching between protected windows and opening gohide.
• Separate taskbar and tray icon options for gohide and selected apps; optional Alt+Tab, Task View and preview hiding.
• Improved protection checks, recovery retries and restoration of original window settings.
• Persistent main-window entry, clearer settings and updated guides for live shopping, teaching, product demos and creative streams.
Ghost Mode requires Pro and Windows 10 version 2004 or later. Icon and switching-entry hiding also affects your local desktop. Results depend on the capture method: test the actual recording or screen share before going live. Cameras and external capture cards are outside this protection.
